title: Boss: start the festival repo

story.speaker: Sam
story.text: Hey! I made some files for the new site.

story.speaker: Sam
story.text: Can you initialize the git repo and commit them? Do `index.html` first, then `menu.html`, then `map.html` in three separate commits so we can track the history clearly.

hints: Add and commit one file at a time: `git add index.html` then `git commit -m "..."`.
Repeat for `menu.html` and `map.html`, then check `git status`.
recap: You've mastered the basics! You can now track your own projects.
